verdict.rationale: Building from source is a fair question for an open-source AI runtime like LocalAI, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a from-source build process or its dependency footprint. The evidence covers only prebuilt distribution (Docker image, a single binary, auto-downloaded backends) and runtime features, which do not count as building from source.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build the runtime from source with minimal external dependencies
